info.cls_ename: Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 複合材料力學主要在講解複合材料之力學性質，以啟發學生分析探討複合材料與結構之性質的相關力學問題的能力。內容包括複合材料單層板、積層板、連續纖維、及不連續纖維複合材料之力學性能分析。
description.describe_eh: Composite material mechanics is mainly to explain the mechanical properties of composite materials, in order to inspire students to analyze and explore the ability of mechanical problems related to the properties of composite materials and structures. The content includes the effective modulus and strength analysis of composite single-layer boards, laminated boards, continuous fibers, and discontinuous fiber composite materials.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂非均向性及正向性複合材料，且能夠描述複合材料之應力及應變關係。
targets.describe_en: Understand what is meant by anisotropic and orthogonal composite materials, and be able to describe the stress and strain relationship of composite materials.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂有效模數，且能夠描述單方向複合材料有效模數之分析原理與計算方法。
targets.describe_en: Understand what the effective modulus is, and be able to describe the microscopic analysis principle and calculation method of the effective modulus of unidirectional composite materials.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂強度，且能夠描述單方向複合材料強度之微觀分析原理與計算方法。
targets.describe_en: Understand what is meant by strength, and be able to describe the microscopic analysis principles and calculation methods of unidirectional composite strength.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明複合材料力學在經濟層面的重要性及影響。
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand and explain the importance and influence of composite material mechanics on the economic level.
